rag_jobs.title: Waikato October 2022 frost station table

rag_jobs.licensing_gate: DataHub non-commercial terms for any public chart; NIWA infographic is CC BY-NC-ND; ISD free.
rag_jobs.app_value: Closes the IBO frost discrepancy and gives a measured grid Tmin bias of about 8 C on a radiative frost night.

rag_jobs.title: NZ monthly fresh blueberry export series
rag_jobs.review_needed: Check HS code continuity before 2015 and any confidential suppression; compare season totals with Fresh Facts values.

rag_jobs.title: AU and NZ disaster and adverse-event records for blueberry districts

rag_jobs.title: Station climate tables for AU/NZ benchmark sites
rag_jobs.review_needed: Choose stations that match farm elevation and distance from sea; document gaps.
